manufacturer: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Nanjing Shunxin Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
mechanism: Oral small-molecule TYK2/JAK1 JH2 allosteric inhibitor. ClinicalTrials.gov describes TQH3906 as a small-molecule tyrosine kinase inhibitor; Sino Biopharmaceutical describes selective pseudo-kinase-domain targeting intended to improve selectivity over traditional JAK kinase-domain inhibitors.
development_status: Not yet recruiting randomized, double-blind, placebo- and active-controlled Phase 2 trial in active psoriatic arthritis in China. The study plans 156 participants, evaluates TQH3906 16 mg and 24 mg once daily versus placebo with a tofacitinib active comparator, and uses Week 12 ACR20 response as the primary endpoint. A related TQH3906 Phase 2 plaque psoriasis study is completed with company-reported positive top-line results, but no posted CT.gov results.
clinical_summary: TQH3906 is being tested as an oral targeted therapy for active PsA with joint and skin endpoints, including ACR20/50/70 and PASI75/90 through Week 12. The related plaque psoriasis Phase 2 program reported dose-response activity, PASI75 above 90% and PASI90 above 70% at the anticipated RP2D after 12 weeks, and company-described efficacy comparable to IL-17/IL-23 biologics. PsA differentiation remains unproven because NCT07406035 is not yet recruiting and no PsA efficacy data are posted; recently approved SOTYKTU already establishes oral TYK2 activity in PsA.
safety_summary: No PsA safety results are posted for TQH3906. NCT07406035 will track AEs, SAEs, discontinuations, AESIs, PK, immunogenicity, laboratory, ECG, and vital-sign outcomes. In the plaque psoriasis Phase 2 announcement, Sino Biopharmaceutical reported comparable AE incidence to placebo, mostly Grade 1 or 2 TEAEs, and no new safety signals. TYK2/JAK analog management should monitor infection, TB, viral hepatitis/reactivation, malignancy, CPK/rhabdomyolysis, lipids/triglycerides, liver enzymes, live-vaccine avoidance, hypersensitivity, and possible JAK-related MACE/thrombosis signals.
management_tools: Prior authorization requiring confirmed active psoriatic arthritis diagnosis
Rheumatologist or dermatologist prescribing or consultation
Step therapy or sequencing after conventional synthetic DMARDs, TNF inhibitors, IL-17 inhibitors, IL-23 inhibitors, or approved oral targeted agents where consistent with plan policy
Quantity limits aligned to approved dose if launched
No concurrent use with biologics or other targeted synthetic oral small molecules for inflammatory disease
Baseline TB screening, hepatitis screening, infection assessment, vaccination review, and avoidance of live vaccines
Continuation criteria tied to objective response measures such as DAPSA, PsAID, CRP/ESR, swollen/tender joint improvement, function, enthesitis/dactylitis improvement, or symptom improvement
Laboratory monitoring for liver enzymes, lipids/triglycerides, blood counts, and CPK based on final label
evidence_gaps: NCT07406035 is not yet recruiting and has no posted PsA results.
The assigned PsA study is China-based and ClinicalTrials.gov lists it as not FDA-regulated.
TQH3906 does not yet have an approved dose, label, U.S. launch plan, or public price.
Mechanism and plaque psoriasis efficacy are supported by company announcement, with detailed Phase 2 data not yet published in a peer-reviewed source.
PsA launch timing is derived from Phase 2 timelines and assumes successful later-stage development.

sources.title: A Phase II Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of TQH3906 Capsules in the Treatment of Active Psoriatic Arthritis
supports: Official title describes a randomized, placebo- and active drug-controlled, double-blind, multicenter, parallel-group Phase 2 trial in active psoriatic arthritis
Lead sponsor is Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Nanjing Shunxin Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
Overall status is not yet recruiting with estimated enrollment of 156 participants
Estimated start is 2026-04, primary completion is 2027-08, and study completion is 2027-11
Treatment arms include TQH3906 Capsule 24 mg, TQH3906 Capsule 16 mg, placebo, and tofacitinib citrate tablet 5 mg
TQH3906 is described as a small-molecule inhibitor of tyrosine kinase
Primary endpoint is proportion achieving ACR20 response at Week 12
Secondary endpoints include ACR20 subgroup response, ACR50, ACR70, PASI75, PASI90, safety events, PK, immunogenicity, laboratory tests, ECG, and vital signs
ClinicalTrials.gov oversight states the study is not FDA-regulated as a drug study and no results are posted

sources.title: Treatment of Moderate to Severe Plaque Psoriasis
supports: Related TQH3906 Phase 2 plaque psoriasis study sponsored by Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Nanjing Shunxin Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
Study status is completed with actual enrollment of 209 participants
Primary endpoint is PASI75 at Week 12
Intervention is TQH3906 capsules versus placebo
No ClinicalTrials.gov results are posted

sources.title: TQH3906 TYK2/JAK1 JH2 Allosteric Inhibitor Achieving Positive Progress in the Phase II Clinical Trial for Plaque Psoriasis
supports: Sino Biopharmaceutical identified TQH3906 as a Category 1 innovative TYK2/JAK1 JH2 allosteric inhibitor independently developed by the group
The completed plaque psoriasis Phase 2 study enrolled 209 patients across placebo and five TQH3906 dose groups with once-daily oral dosing
At the anticipated RP2D after 12 weeks, company reported PASI75 above 90% and PASI90 above 70%, versus about 10% and 5% for placebo
Company reported favorable safety and tolerability, comparable AE incidence to placebo, mostly Grade 1 or 2 TEAEs, and no new safety signals
Company states TQH3906 targets the TYK2/JAK1 pseudo-kinase domain and may offer higher selectivity and potentially superior safety versus traditional JAK inhibitors
Company states it will continue investigating TQH3906 in autoimmune and dermatology indications including psoriatic arthritis

sources.title: SOTYKTU (deucravacitinib) Prescribing Information
supports: SOTYKTU is a TYK2 inhibitor indicated for active psoriatic arthritis in adults
Recommended dose is 6 mg orally once daily
Mechanism is allosteric TYK2 inhibition through binding to the regulatory domain
PsA trials PsA-1 and PsA-2 showed statistically significant ACR20 improvement versus placebo at Week 16

Label warnings include hypersensitivity, infections, TB evaluation, malignancy, rhabdomyolysis/elevated CPK, triglycerides and liver enzymes, live vaccine avoidance, and potential risks related to JAK inhibition

Drugs.com lists Sotyktu as brand only with no generic version available

expected_launch_window.method: Derived from not-yet-recruiting Phase 2 PsA status, estimated primary completion in 2027-08, expected need for Phase 3 PsA development, and the absence of an FDA-regulated U.S. trial or public filing plan.
expected_launch_window.explanation: A PsA launch before 2031 appears unlikely because the assigned study has not begun recruitment and later-stage confirmatory development would still be required. Positive plaque psoriasis data support continued development but do not remove PsA efficacy and regulatory uncertainty.

annual_cost_range.method: Used current U.S. oral immunology targeted-therapy analogs. Low equals Sotyktu $6,977.91 per 30 tablets multiplied by 12 months. High equals RINVOQ WAC $7,090.41 per 30-day supply multiplied by 12 months.
annual_cost_range.explanation: TQH3906 is unapproved and unpriced. If launched and priced like branded oral TYK2/JAK immunology therapies, gross annual drug acquisition cost would likely be about $84K-$85K before rebates, discounts, patient assistance, adherence effects, or plan-specific utilization.

clinical_differentiation.method: Weighted oral once-daily route, dual TYK2/JAK1 JH2 allosteric mechanism, strong company-reported plaque psoriasis Phase 2 skin responses, and active PsA endpoints against no posted PsA data and the presence of approved oral TYK2/JAK options.
clinical_differentiation.explanation: TQH3906 could be differentiated if PsA joint efficacy and safety match the plaque psoriasis signal, but current PsA evidence is pre-readout and SOTYKTU already validates oral TYK2 use in PsA.

budget_impact.method: Combined high annual oral targeted-therapy analog costs, chronic PsA treatment duration, broad specialty-immunology population, and likely PA/step controls.
budget_impact.explanation: Even with utilization management and a crowded market, a new branded oral PsA therapy priced near approved TYK2/JAK analogs would carry high per-patient spend and meaningful formulary impact.

disruption_risk.method: Assessed route, mechanism, company-reported PsO efficacy, PsA trial design with tofacitinib active comparator, and early/not-yet-recruiting PsA evidence status.
disruption_risk.explanation: A convenient oral agent with high skin response and acceptable safety could pressure existing oral and injectable sequencing, but no PsA data are available and approved TYK2/JAK competitors already exist.

recommended_action.method: Mapped pre-recruitment Phase 2 PsA status, no posted PsA results, and derived launch timing beyond near-term planning windows to monitoring rather than active launch preparation.
recommended_action.explanation: Track NCT07406035 recruitment, Week 12 ACR/PASI readouts, safety differentiation versus JAK/TYK2 analogs, China regulatory progress, and any U.S./global development signals before preparing coverage policy.
